headline: Mac Miller’s handwritten message is still inside the empty pool in the basement of The Rav
body: Mac Miller’s handwritten message is still inside the empty pool in the basement of The Rave/Eagles Club 🕊️❤️ An empty basement pool is probably the last place you’d expect to find a little piece of music history, but tucked beneath the venue is a message Mac left behind that’s still there today. 🥹 There’s something about seeing his actual handwriting in the same spot where he wrote it. A moment from his visit is still sitting on those pool walls, and what might have seemed like a small thing at the time means so much more now. Hopefully that message stays right where it is for years to come. A special piece of Mac’s history in an unexpected place. ❤️

source_caption_text:
Mac Miller’s handwritten message is still inside the empty pool in the basement of The Rave/Eagles Club 🕊️❤️

An empty basement pool is probably the last place you’d expect to find a little piece of music history, but tucked beneath the venue is a message Mac left behind that’s still there today. 🥹

There’s something about seeing his actual handwriting in the same spot where he wrote it. A moment from his visit is still sitting on those pool walls, and what might have seemed like a small thing at the time means so much more now.

Hopefully that message stays right where it is for years to come. A special piece of Mac’s history in an unexpected place. ❤️
